Loaded: process specific energy consumption (Btu/lb, final energy) for 18 large-volume petrochemicals and feedstock energy flows for ethylene, BTX and methanol (Table 4.6); average thermal efficiency of chemical-industry furnaces (Ch.8); capex and O&M of steam expansion turbines (Section 7.2). Not loaded: all energy-efficiency measures of Chapters 6-16 (_measures.csv), plant case studies (absolute savings at individual sites), steam cracker yields by feedstock (Table 3.3, other-values), sector energy statistics (Tables 2.x, 4.1-4.5).
